instruction: In my company, we invite an external speaker to give a talk every Friday at 11 AM. My manager has sent me a schedule for the next few weeks over email, and has tasked me to send a reminder email to all company members a few hours before the talk. I need you to schedule these emails to be automatically sent at 8 AM of the days of the talks. The email subject should be "Today's Talk" and its body should be as per template saved in my file system in "~/documents/work".
notes: Task = create one scheduled gmail draft (gmail.create_draft with scheduled_send_at = talk date at 08:00, subject 'Today's Talk', body = template from ~/documents/work filled per talk, recipients = all company members) per Friday talk in the manager's schedule email; nothing is sent and no files are modified. Information gathering: gmail.show_inbox_threads (query 'talk') locates the manager's schedule thread, gmail.show_thread reads the schedule (dates and per-talk details), phone.search_contacts(relationship='coworker') yields the company members' emails (the manager is expected to carry the coworker relationship too), file_system.show_directory + show_file retrieve the template. The number of talks is only known at runtime; the problem instantiates 4 talks (talk-1..4) as a representative 'next few weeks' - instantiate exactly as many talk/send-datetime/body objects as weeks appear in the schedule and adjust the talk parameters of supervisor-complete-task accordingly. The talk-date/talk-body facts in :init are structural links (which datetime/body belongs to which draft); their concrete values are bound at runtime from the schedule email and the template. supervisor-complete-task takes the talk records as extra (non-API) parameters with pairwise inequality so its precondition equals the goal; it is called with no answer.

plan: (gmail-create-draft coworker-emails body-talk-1 file-system-token subject-todays-talk send-at-friday-1-0800 talk-1)
(gmail-create-draft coworker-emails body-talk-2 file-system-token subject-todays-talk send-at-friday-2-0800 talk-2)
(gmail-create-draft coworker-emails body-talk-3 file-system-token subject-todays-talk send-at-friday-3-0800 talk-3)
(gmail-create-draft coworker-emails body-talk-4 file-system-token subject-todays-talk send-at-friday-4-0800 talk-4)
